(Presently Lodged In Distt. Jail Dungarpur)
 ----Petitioner  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Vali W/o Kaliya Dindor, Bajar Salopat Banswara (Raj.)

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Urja Ram Kalbi, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 10/01/2025 This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.196/2023, registered at Police Station Salopat, Dist. Banswara, for the offences under Sections 363, 366, 344, 376(2)
(n) of IPC and Sections 5(l)/6 of POCSO Act.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
As per the prosecution, the victim- 'C' aged about 12 years was forcibly abducted and thereafter subjected to sexual assault- rape by the petitioner who is aged about 21 years.

This Court, after perusing the challan papers and the statements of the victim- 'C' recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., finds that there is prima facie evidence available on record against the petitioner that he committed sexual assault- rape on the [2025:RJ-JD:1785] (2 of 2)
[CRLMB-10030/2024] victim- 'C'.
Further, considering the fact that the victim- 'C' is a girl of 12 years, who was allegedly subjected to rape, the gravity of the offence is obvious.
